stem: Meera's mother is choosing a packaged evening snack for the family. She compares the nutrition labels of two foods, given per 100 g. Food P has 530 kcal, 33 g fat, 6 g protein and 4 g dietary fibre. Food Q has 360 kcal, 7 g fat, 18 g protein and 15 g dietary fibre. Junk foods are high in calories and fat but low in protein and dietary fibre. Which statement correctly identifies the food that better fits the junk-food pattern?

options.text: Food P, because it has more calories and fat but less protein and dietary fibre
Food Q, because its higher dietary fibre makes it more filling
Food Q, because it has more protein per 100 g
Both foods fit the junk-food pattern equally, since both are packaged foods

teacher.key_rationale: Food P has the higher calories (530 vs 360 kcal) and fat (33 g vs 7 g) with lower protein (6 g vs 18 g) and dietary fibre (4 g vs 15 g), so it matches the junk-food pattern; the key is A.
